rationale: Intraday momentum is down — price sits at the day's low after breaking prior-day support, well below both VWAP ($10.26) and the 9-EMA ($10.18) — but the last five minutes show ranges collapsed to zero and volume drying up at $10.13, meaning the down leg has stalled with no reversal trigger (no reclaim of the EMA or VWAP) to justify a long. Shorting offers poor location at the exact low of a 1M-share float that has already turned over twice today, where a routine bounce toward the EMA would hit a tight stop before the $10.00 target pays. With no news catalyst and both directions unconfirmed, the higher-EV action is to wait for either a breakdown of the $10.13 shelf on volume (short) or a VWAP reclaim (long) before committing capital.
